_about: Upgrade (craft) success chances (the owner, 2026-11-08: "right now the combining modification changes drop too fast 100% on the same level, 50 and 25% for levels lower", "it should be 100, 95, 90", then "i would honestly also make it 100% always"). gameplay/items/craft/craft.options, read only by the server: craft_probabilities_premium[d] = [success %, failure %] for an item with d = 0, 1, 2 more modifications than its donor, the one chance table srp reads (silver only, docs/notes/silver-only.md: the game's gold upgrade, in silver; craft_probabilities_general is not read). Success 100/50/25 -> 100/100/100: an upgrade always adds a modification. Failure 25 -> 0 in the last row: none is left.
